  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Migrating supported Mplus-like syntax}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

DSEMr implements a clean-room, deliberately limited compatibility language.
Unsupported statements fail instead of being silently ignored.

```{r}
library(DSEMr)
lavaan_model <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", time = "time")
mplus_model <- mplus_to_dsem("
  ANALYSIS: TYPE = BAYES;
  MODEL:
    %WITHIN%
    y ON y&1;
", time = "time")
identical(lavaan_model$terms, mplus_model$terms)
```

Compatibility claims are tracked per example in `docs/PARITY.md`; parsing an
operator is not evidence that its estimator is available.
